---
title: "Daily Translation: Oversleeping and Forgetting a Wallet"
author: "Ryan Sun"
date: "2026-09-01"
categories: [English Learning, Daily Translation]
---

## 中文原文

早上闹钟响了好几次，你起晚了。来不及做早餐，抓了面包就出门赶地铁。地铁里人非常拥挤，你好不容易挤上去，结果发现自己忘记带钱包。

## My translation

Even my alarm rang for a couple of times, I got up late this morning. There was no time for making a breakfast, so I grabbed a bread and went out to catch up subway. It was very crowded in the subway station. I tried my best to get up on one train, then I found that I forgot to bring my wallet.

## Revised version

Even though my alarm went off a couple of times, I still slept in this morning. I had no time for breakfast, so I grabbed some bread and headed out to catch the subway. The train was packed. I struggled to get on, only to realize I’d forgotten my wallet.

## Key phrases

- **alarm went off**：闹钟响（最地道，不用 *rang* 描述闹钟）
- **slept in**：睡过头、起晚，比 *got up late* 更口语
- **headed out**：动身出门，替换 *went out*
- **be packed**：（交通工具）挤得水泄不通，替代 *very crowded*
- **struggled to get on**：费劲挤上去
- **only to realize…**：结果却发现……，适合表达意外的糟心事
- **I’d forgotten = I had forgotten**：过去完成时，表示在上车前就已经忘了，时态更严谨
